guarantees.claim: sp_enc_err is driven by the bitwise OR of sp2v_sig_err's bits ORed with sp_enc_err_i.
start_o is permanently driven to logic 0.
key_iv_data_in_clear_o is permanently driven to logic 0.
data_out_clear_o is permanently driven to logic 0.

uncertain_points.claim: key_iv_data_in_clear_o and data_out_clear_o are tied to 0, potentially leaving sensitive key/IV or output data uncleared if these signals are intended to trigger clearing of secret material.
uncertain_points.cond: if the design expects these clear signals to be asserted to wipe sensitive registers
uncertain_points.risk: secret key and data may remain in flops longer than necessary, enabling exposure after operation or under fault conditions.

uncertain_points.claim: start_o is always 0, so this module never issues a start trigger; it is unclear whether external logic expects a start pulse or whether this module is intentionally unused.
uncertain_points.risk: if downstream FSM awaits start_o assertion, it will stall indefinitely.
